synthesizedFacts.fact: Pregnancy can cause a 'glow' due to increased blood circulation and hormonal changes that stimulate oil glands.
Hyperpigmentation, such as melasma or chloasma, is common during pregnancy due to hormonal fluctuations.
Stretch marks affect nearly 90% of pregnant women and are influenced by genetic factors.
Pregnancy can lead to increased skin sensitivity, making it important to use gentle skincare products.
Spider veins and varicose veins can develop due to increased blood volume and pressure during pregnancy.
